biggest_catch: All payouts are in Mistplay units, not cash — 500 bonus units are worth well under $2 at Mistplay's redemption rates, and you only unlock referrals after reaching Checkpoint 5 yourself.
catches: You must reach Checkpoint 5 in a game yourself before you can refer anyone.
150 units pay when the friend signs up through your unique link; the other 350 pay only if they install a game and reach Checkpoint 5.
If your friend does not install a game within one month, they are removed from your referrals.
The 15% ongoing cut applies only to your first five successful referrals — unlimited invites, but the percentage is capped at five.
The referred friend gets 100 bonus units on top of the usual 200 welcome units — they must use your link to get it.
Unit value is modest and third-party sources cite roughly $0.28 per 100 units; official terms quote units, not dollars, so treat any dollar estimate as approximate, not guaranteed.

c1.evidence: Mistplay — established loyalty platform; official pages on mistplay.com and support.mistplay.com.

c2.evidence: Official blog 'Mistplay Referral Program' plus support article 'How does the referral program work' state the unit payouts.

c3.evidence: Free to join; no upfront fee or participation cost stated.

c4.evidence: Official terms: 150 units at signup, 350 more at friend's Checkpoint 5, 15% of the first five referrals' units ongoing, 100 bonus units for the friend.

eligibility: You must have reached Checkpoint 5 in a Mistplay game to unlock referrals. New users must sign up through your unique referral link; the friend must install a selected game within one month and reach Checkpoint 5 for the full payout.
notes: Catalog claimed only 'Bonus units per referral'; official terms specify 150 units at signup plus 350 units at the friend's Checkpoint 5, 15% of the first five referrals' units ongoing, and 100 bonus units for the friend — corrected. Units are not dollars: no official dollar conversion exists.
payout_quote: A friend referral is only considered 'successful' once they sign up to join Mistplay through your unique referral link, giving you 150 bonus units. They must then proceed to install a game from their selection and reach Checkpoint 5 in it. At that point, you'll get 350 more bonus units, plus extra units equal to 15% of what those first five friends earn going forward.

s2.note: No participation fee; payouts are in units, not cash — disclosed honestly.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: reach Checkpoint 5, share link, friend signs up, friend installs a game and reaches Checkpoint 5.

s7.note: Official Mistplay blog and support articles reviewed 2026-09-23.

steps: Reach Checkpoint 5 in a Mistplay game yourself to unlock your referral link.
Share your unique referral link; your friend signs up through it — that pays you 150 bonus units, and they get 100 bonus units on top of the usual 200 welcome units.
Your friend installs a selected game from their Mistplay list (within one month, or they are removed from your referrals).
When your friend reaches Checkpoint 5 in that game, you get 350 more bonus units, plus 15% of what your first five referrals earn going forward.
timing: 150 units at friend signup; 350 more units when the friend reaches Checkpoint 5; 15% of the first five referrals' units ongoing.
